title: Grateful Dead Live at West High Auditorium on 1980-06-21
lineage: Master played back on Nak Dragon> Grace Lunatec V3 (24/96)> Digital Audio Labs Card Deluxe> Adobe Audition 2.0 (dither/downsample)> FLAC encoding
source: 2 Nak 700s with bass eq mounted on pole> Sony TC-D5 (2 Maxell UD XL-IIs)

ai_review.summary: A stellar audience tape of an iconic 1980 Alaska show, featuring a fire‑filled setlist and crystal‑clear mids/low end with only slightly muffled highs.
ai_review.review: The performance is repeatedly described as one of the band’s top shows of the era – every song “on fire,” with standout renditions of Sugaree, Lazy Lightning → Supplication, Feel Like a Stranger, Terrapin and Playin’ in the Band. The audience recording is hailed as a gem: well‑balanced, clear and surprisingly detailed for an AUD source, with only minor high‑frequency dullness.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews (7/8) are highly enthusiastic about both the musical performance and the audience recording, yielding a strong consensus of excellent show quality and excellent recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Aud tape praised as a GEM; mids and low end are well‑balanced, overall clarity is high. A few reviewers note the highs are slightly muffled but this does not detract from the listening experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers highlight a strong, energetic set list that captures the vibe of late‑’70s shows; the flow is described as fire‑filled and consistently high‑energy throughout.
